ruleDefinitions.name: Potentially Suspicious Child Process Of Regsvr32
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potentially suspicious child processes of "regsvr32.exe".

sequences.query: (parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\regsvr32\\\.exe$") AND (process_path = RGX("\\\\calc\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\cscript\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\explorer\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\mshta\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\net\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\net1\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\nltest\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\notepad\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\reg\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\schtasks\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\werfault\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\wscript\\\.exe$"))) AND  NOT ((process_path = RGX("\\\\werfault\\\.exe$") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-u\\ \\-p\\ .*")))
